name: Cisco ASA — Large Outbound TCP Egress (≥50MB)
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014"
| alter int_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
        ext_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
        int_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_port),
        ext_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
        proto    = _json -> generalCiscoLog.protocol,
        bytes_n  = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes),
        int_iface = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface
| filter int_iface = "inside" and bytes_n >= 50000000
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp sum(bytes_n) as exfil_bytes,
       values(ext_host) as ext_hosts,
       values(ext_port) as ext_ports,
       values(int_port) as int_ports,
       values(proto) as protocols
       by int_host, _time
| filter exfil_bytes >= 50000000
| fields ext_hosts, ext_ports, int_ports, protocols, int_host
description: Cisco ASA Teardown (302014) from internal host with transferred_bytes ≥ 50MB summed across one hour — bulk data exfiltration.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — Large Outbound TCP Egress (≥50MB)
